## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat: add booking quote`)
- [ ] Branch targets `dev` (or `main` for a release or hotfix PR)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and CI is green on the pushed commit
- [ ] Migrations included and reversible (API changes)
- [ ] OpenAPI schema and generated client updated (API contract changes)
- [ ] UI matches the original design (`docs/design/legacy-ui-reference.md`): no shadows, shadcn components only
- [ ] Loading, empty, warning and error states covered, including pending buttons
- [ ] Keyboard and screen-reader accessible; axe check passes
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, `.env.example`)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or data dumps committed
